STEP 1 - Scene: An airline-style tray meal (economy-type service) with several small compartments: shredded meat, a vegetable salad, fried rice-like dish with mushrooms, pasta/tortellini-like pieces in red sauce, a fruit cup, a glass of water, and a bottle of dark drink. Photo taken from a fairly high front-on angle, looking down at the tray. A color calibration chart sits in the foreground.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The main plates are paper/compostable plates roughly 20 cm diameter (side-plate size). The tray spans about 50 cm, consistent with this. Using the central plate (fried rice and pasta plates) as ~20 cm: area = 3.14 x 10^2 = 314 cm^2. Bowls at the top are ~15 cm (area ~177 cm^2).

STEP 3 - Items (of this meal, excluding the calibration chart):
- Shredded cooked chicken/poultry (left plate)
- Mixed vegetable salad: carrot sticks, corn, lettuce (top-left bowl)
- Fried rice with mushrooms and pepper (center plate)
- Tortellini-like pasta in tomato/meat sauce (right plate)
- Mixed fruit: watermelon, papaya, melon (top-right bowl)
- Water (glass) and dark beverage (bottle), not counted in solid food

STEP 4 - Area (on each vessel):
- Chicken on ~20 cm plate: covers ~40% of plate (~126 cm^2), 1.0 cm thick, volume ≈ 126 ml x 0.9 → ~113 g
- Fried rice on 20 cm plate: covers ~70% (~220 cm^2), 2 cm → 440 ml x 0.8 → ~350 g
- Tortellini on 20 cm plate: covers ~60% (~190 cm^2), 1.8 cm → 340 ml x 0.9 → ~300 g (sauced, dense)
- Vegetable bowl (15 cm, ~177 cm^2): ~70% covered, 2 cm → 250 ml x 0.15 for leafy/mixed → mostly carrot/corn, use 0.5 → ~125 g
- Fruit bowl (15 cm): ~80% covered, 2.5 cm → 354 ml x 0.6 → ~210 g

STEP 5-6 - Grams are as above (volume × bulk density already applied).

STEP 7 - Energy (per 100 g, as plated):
- Chicken, cooked: ~165 kcal → 113 g → 186 kcal
- Fried rice with mushroom: ~150 kcal → 350 g → 525 kcal
- Tortellini in tomato/meat sauce: ~180 kcal → 300 g → 540 kcal
- Mixed vegetables (carrot, corn, lettuce): ~45 kcal → 125 g → 56 kcal
- Fruit (watermelon, papaya, melon): ~45 kcal → 210 g → 95 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total solid food ≈ 1,098 g, ≈ 1,400 kcal. Three substantial main compartments plus two bowls and a sizable glass of drink is plausible for a full tray meal, though the plates appear partly used, so these figures are moderate estimates.
